project_1.name: Digital Products
project_1.purpose: Leverage's first and current business project. Multiple digital products can be created, launched, marketed and measured inside P-001.

project_2.name: Affiliate Project
project_2.purpose: Technology-powered automotive recommendation and acquisition engine using research, affiliate offers and automated content distribution.

projects.name: Digital Products
projects.description: Leverage's first business project. It is a reusable digital-product portfolio, not a single-product project. Future digital products belong inside P-001 unless the Owner explicitly creates a separate project.

acquisition_assets.name: Leverage Free Fabrication Tool Network
acquisition_assets.purpose: Acquire organic traffic and qualified interest for P001-DP01 and future P-001 products. This is an acquisition asset, not a separate business project.

projects.next_gate: Acquire and verify the first customer for P001-DP01, then use the same product engine to evaluate additional digital products inside P-001.

projects.name: Affiliate Project
projects.description: Automated automotive affiliate recommendation engine: discover real buyer problems, research products and offers, create useful video content, distribute through permitted platform workflows, measure results and continuously optimize.

strategy.business_model: Demand intelligence -> product recommendation -> content/distribution -> affiliate commission -> measurement -> learning
strategy.automation_target: End-to-end automation from research through video production, distribution, analytics and next-opportunity generation
strategy.owner_role: Strategy, approvals and consequential external actions only
strategy.capital_policy: RM0-first; no paid acquisition without explicit Owner approval

continue_list.name: Existing System Audit
continue_list.description: Audit current Leverage architecture, workers, APIs, dashboard and reusable automation before modifying anything.

continue_list.name: Research Automation
continue_list.description: Automate Reddit, trend, competitor, buyer-question and market research collection.

continue_list.name: Opportunity Engine
continue_list.description: Detect, deduplicate, score and prioritize automotive opportunities.

continue_list.name: Product & Affiliate Engine
continue_list.description: Research products, offers, availability, economics and affiliate eligibility.

continue_list.name: Content Intelligence
continue_list.description: Generate angles, hooks, scripts, titles, descriptions and platform-specific content plans.

continue_list.name: Video Production Engine
continue_list.description: Automate voice, visuals, captions, editing, thumbnails and finished video assets using available zero-cost tooling first.

continue_list.name: Distribution Engine
continue_list.description: Prepare, schedule and publish content through officially supported platform workflows; respect required human/platform gates.

continue_list.name: Analytics Engine
continue_list.description: Collect content, click, conversion, commission and revenue evidence.

continue_list.name: Learning & Optimization
continue_list.description: Detect winners and losers, explain patterns and automatically generate the next experiments.

continue_list.name: End-to-End Autonomous Loop
continue_list.description: Run the complete demand-to-revenue loop continuously with safety and approval controls.

product_strategy.selection_rule: Prefer automotive products that solve clear problems, have strong buyer intent, useful demonstration potential, meaningful economics and legitimate affiliate availability.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.role: Primary discovery and first affiliate-commerce channel
platforms.automation: research -> script -> video -> publishing workflow subject to platform access and controls

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.monetization: YouTube Shopping when eligible + permitted affiliate programs
platforms.automation: research -> video -> metadata -> publishing workflow subject to platform access and controls

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.monetization: Not treated as a spam/distribution channel
platforms.automation: research and signal extraction only; contribution must respect subreddit rules

projects.next_gate: Complete B1 system audit, then implement the automotive acquisition pipeline without duplicating existing Leverage capabilities.
